_comment: Reference handshape templates for ASL fingerspelling. Populated from TemplateRecorder output - see docs/JOINTS.md for landmark meaning and Assets/Scripts/LandmarkCapture.ts for the normalization. Each sample is a 78-dim vector: 26 landmarks x 3 axes, wrist-origin, orthonormal basis from wrist->middleKnuckle and the knuckle spread, scaled by the wrist->middleKnuckle distance.
